title: Sparkly fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d42a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff9a9a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff6a6a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M12 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 14 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M90 46 l1.3 3.2 l3.2 1.3 l-3.2 1.3 l-1.3 3.2 l-1.3 -3.2 l-3.2 -1.3 l3.2 -1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M10 62 l1.3 3.2 l3.2 1.3 l-3.2 1.3 l-1.3 3.2 l-1.3 -3.2 l-3.2 -1.3 l3.2 -1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M24 78 l1.3 3.2 l3.2 1.3 l-3.2 1.3 l-1.3 3.2 l-1.3 -3.2 l-3.2 -1.3 l3.2 -1.3 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <g stroke='#f0f0f0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='46' y1='40' x2='92' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='50' x2='92' y2='36'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='40' x2='56' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='36' x2='68' y2='46'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='32' x2='80' y2='42'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hose coiled on top -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='6' fill='#e8e8e8' stroke='#c0c0c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <!-- back body -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='56' height='26' rx='4' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#bodyShade)'/>
  <!-- equipment boxes -->
  <rect x='24' y='58' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='40' y='58' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <path d='M64 74 L64 46 Q64 42 68 42 L84 42 Q88 42 88 48 L88 74 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <path d='M64 46 Q64 42 68 42 L84 42 Q88 42 88 48 L88 52 L64 52 Z' fill='url(#bodyShade)'/>
  <!-- windshield -->
  <rect x='69' y='48' width='15' height='11' rx='2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- side window -->
  <rect x='57' y='58' width='10' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='76' r='9' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='76' r='4.5' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='9' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='4.5' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='16' y='72' width='6' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <rect x='87' y='72' width='5' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='66' r='3' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <!-- siren light -->
  <rect x='70' y='35' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#5ad1ff'/>
  <rect x='70' y='35' width='10' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
</svg>
